title: Why did adding a second memory slot on a MacBook make Med Agent Hub 3x faster to start answering?
summary: When a local AI server only keeps one conversation in active memory at a time, any background helper task evicts the patient chart and forces the AI to re-read thousands of words on the next question. On a 64 GB Apple Silicon MacBook running Gemma 4 12B, we configured two concurrent memory slots and compared Med Agent Hub against built-in ChartSearchAI across 17 HIV chart scenarios (35 questions per setup).
takeaway: Giving the local server two active memory slots raised Med Agent Hub's chart-memory reuse from 0% to 84%, cutting median wait for the first word by 3.3x (34.0s down to 10.3s) and full-answer time by 3.0x (35.9s down to 12.1s). At the same time, Med Agent Hub maintained its clinical quality and safety lead over built-in ChartSearchAI (79.8 vs. 75.9/100, with zero unsafe answers and zero invented facts vs. 1 of each on built-in).
